items.essay: Some people think that university education should be free for everyone. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write about 180 words.
Many students choose a university subject because it can lead to a well-paid job. Why do they do this? Is it a positive or negative development? Write about 180 words.
Artificial intelligence is now used in schools, hospitals and offices. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this? Write about 180 words.
Governments should control what people post on social media. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write about 180 words.
Children today spend more time on screens and less time playing outside. Why is this happening, and what can parents and schools do about it? Write about 180 words.
More and more people are working from home. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this? Write about 180 words.

Some people believe that young people should start working while they are still students. Others think that students should only focus on their studies. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write about 180 words.

Some people believe that smartphones make people closer to their families and friends. Others think that they reduce face-to-face communication. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write about 180 words.
In many countries, young people are getting married later than in the past. What are the causes of this, and what effects does it have? Write about 180 words.
Individuals can do little to protect the environment; only governments can make a real difference. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write about 180 words.
Governments should spend money to protect endangered animals. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write about 180 words.
Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest? Write about 180 words.
More and more people are moving from villages to big cities. What problems does this cause, and what solutions can you suggest? Write about 180 words.
Many old buildings in cities are being replaced by modern ones. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this? Write about 180 words.
Unhealthy food and drinks should have higher taxes to reduce health problems. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write about 180 words.
Mental health problems are becoming more common among young people. What are the causes of this, and what can be done to help? Write about 180 words.
